'''Docking Bay 12''' was a docking bay in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] known as [[Muftak/Legends|Muftak]] was abandoned as a child on the steps of the docking bay.
